name: open-archiver
description: Search, read and (with your approval) delete emails in your self-hosted Open Archiver.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Open Archiver email archive on your home network. Tools: search_emails, get_email, archive_overview (read-only) and delete_emails (permanent, needs Allow Deletion on the server). Runs locally on this computer, has no third-party dependencies and opens no ports. The API key is stored in the operating system's secure store.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Full-text search of the archive, including attachment text (read-only).

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Read one archived email in full, with its thread (read-only).

tools.name: archive_overview
tools.description: Archive totals, sources and indexing health (read-only).

tools.name: delete_emails
tools.description: Permanently delete approved emails from the archive.

oa_url.title: Open Archiver address
oa_url.description: The address you open in the browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.77:3000

oa_api_key.title: API key
oa_api_key.description: Create it in Open Archiver under Settings > API Keys, signed in as the dedicated Claude user.
